findings.title: `float: right` on `.small-action button` is ignored now that `.small-action` is a flex container
findings.body: `.small-action` is now `display: flex` (via the `flexbox()` mixin), which makes its direct children flex items. Per the flexbox spec, `float` has no effect on flex items, so the `float: right` left on `.small-action button` no longer pushes the action button (e.g. the edit/show-all control on small-action posts) to the right edge. Because `.small-action-desc` has no `flex: 1`/`flex-grow`, the button will now sit immediately after the description text instead of right-aligned, a visible layout regression. Either give `.small-action-desc` `flex: 1` or replace the float with `margin-left: auto` on the button (and drop the now-dead `float: left` on `.topic-avatar`).

findings.title: `align-items` mixin passes modern keywords unchanged to legacy syntaxes with a different vocabulary, and emits a non-existent `-ms-align-items` property
findings.body: The `align-items($alignment)` mixin forwards `$alignment` verbatim to `-webkit-box-align` (2009 box spec) and `-ms-flex-align` (IE10 tweener spec). Those legacy properties accept `start`/`end`/`center`/`baseline`/`stretch`, not `flex-start`/`flex-end`. The current call sites only use `center` and `baseline`, which happen to overlap, but any future `@include align-items(flex-start)` will silently produce invalid declarations for the very browsers the prefixes are meant to support. The mixin should map `flex-start`→`start` and `flex-end`→`end` for the legacy outputs. Additionally, `-ms-align-items` (line 121) is not a property any version of IE ever implemented and only adds dead bytes to the compiled CSS.

findings.title: `margin-left: auto` does not right-align `.panel` in browsers that fall back to `display: -webkit-box`
findings.body: The previous `float: right` on `.d-header .panel` was replaced with `margin-left: auto` inside a flex container. In the 2009 `-webkit-box` layout mode, which the new `flexbox()` mixin explicitly emits as a fallback for old WebKit (e.g. Android 2.x–4.3 stock browser, Safari 6), `auto` margins on box children are not honored, so the header panel (notifications/user icons) will no longer be pushed to the right in those browsers; it will sit directly after the title. If those engines are considered unsupported the `-webkit-box`/`-moz-box` lines should be dropped from the mixins; if they are supported, the panel needs an explicit `-webkit-box-flex`/spacer approach or the `float` should be kept as a fallback.

findings.title: PR title claims a performance optimization that the change does not make; description is a placeholder
findings.body: The PR is titled "Optimize header layout performance with flexbox mixins" and described only as "Test 5". The diff replaces float-based layout with flexbox and reflows `.small-action` and category badge spacing; nothing in it measurably affects rendering performance (flexbox is not faster than floats, and the header's scroll performance hint `backface-visibility: hidden` is untouched). A reviewer or future git-blame reader will be misled about the intent, and the visual changes to `.small-action` padding/margins and the header panel alignment are not mentioned anywhere. The title and description should accurately state that this is a visual/layout refactor to flexbox and list the intentional spacing changes.
